column1: #  avanza_test_16mb_ota.csv — 16 MB ESP32-S3
#  The no-OTA table (avanza_test_16mb.csv) gives every spare byte to captures.
#  This one buys OTA with 2 MB of that: a second app slot the bootloader can
#  switch to. Worth it once frames stream to a laptop instead of to flash
#  because then capture space stops being the scarce thing and USB access is.
#      nvs         20 KB
#      otadata      8 KB   which slot the bootloader should start
#      app0      2048 KB   firmware
#      app1      2048 KB   firmware
#      spiffs   12224 KB   LittleFS — raw CAN captures and identifier notes
#  MOVING TO OR FROM THIS TABLE ERASES THE CAPTURES. The data region starts at
#  a different offset
column2: so whatever LittleFS held is no longer addressable.

column1: #  Pull the captures and the notes BEFORE flashing a different table.
#  Changing the table itself requires USB: the bootloader reads it from a fixed
#  offset
column2: and OTA only ever writes into an app slot.
